title: Tier Review Interval, Grace Months and Step-Down Limit by Paloma Rewards Tier
content:
Paloma Rewards tiers are reviewed at a fixed interval counted from enrollment, and each tier sets how long a member may keep it after falling below its threshold at a review and how far the member can drop at one review.

| Tier | Months between tier reviews | Grace months after falling below the tier at a review | Most tiers dropped at one review |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 12 | 0 | 1 |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 12 | 0 | 1 |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 12 | 3 | 1 |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 12 | 3 | 1 |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 12 | 6 | 1 |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 12 | 6 | 2 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Months between tier reviews**: the number of months from enrollment to the first tier review, and from each review to the next.
- **Grace months**: the months a member keeps this tier after falling below its threshold at a review. A value of 0 means the tier carries no grace period.
- **Most tiers dropped at one review**: the largest number of tiers a member holding this tier can move down at a single review.

## Reading the table

- Every tier is reviewed on the same 12-month interval.
- Paloma Rewards Blue and Paloma Rewards Silver carry 0 grace months; Paloma Rewards Gold and Paloma Rewards Platinum carry 3; Paloma Rewards Diamond and Paloma Rewards Elite carry 6.
- Paloma Rewards Elite is the only tier from which a member can move down 2 tiers at one review; from every other tier the limit is 1.
- Illustration with hypothetical dates: a member who enrolled on 15 March 2026 has a first review 12 months later, on 15 March 2027.
